title: Lion cub eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- snack: a little biscuit/cookie -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='82' rx='13' ry='8' fill='#e8a33c'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='80.5' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#f7c464'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='78' r='1.6' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='81' r='1.6' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='76' r='1.4' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='77' r='1.2' fill='#a8622a'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#e9b34a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f2c96a'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f2c96a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M78 66 q12 -2 12 -12' stroke='#e9b34a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='91' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#b3702a'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='22' fill='#f2c96a'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <g fill='#c07427'>
    <circle cx='42' cy='14' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='17' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='28' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='44' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='55' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='27' cy='55' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='19' cy='44' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='19' cy='28' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='27' cy='17' r='7'/>
  </g>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='20' r='6' fill='#f2c96a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='20' r='6' fill='#f2c96a'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='20' r='3' fill='#e08b8b'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='20' r='3' fill='#e08b8b'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='33' r='4' fill='#5a3210'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='4' fill='#5a3210'/>
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='31.5' r='1.5' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <circle cx='51.5' cy='31.5' r='1.5' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='41' r='3' fill='#f09a9a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='41' r='3' fill='#f09a9a'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='44' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#fbe7b8'/>
  <path d='M39 41 h6 l-3 3 z' fill='#8a4a1c'/>
  <path d='M42 44 q-4 4 -7 1' stroke='#8a4a1c' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 44 q4 4 7 1' stroke='#8a4a1c' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little crumb on cheek -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#f7c464'/>
</svg>
